executive_verdict.primary_failure_mode: Reproduced grounding, transport and stale-result defects are fixed; live model quality and production resource isolation remain unverified.
executive_verdict.most_urgent_fix: Next evidence: live synthetic Kimi evaluation. Before untrusted business use: hard PDF parser resource isolation and deployment controls.

model_stack: Optional NVIDIA Kimi adapter; no live account-key test
scope.method: ECC architect, Python/provider and security guidance; code review, synthetic reproductions and regression tests. ECC is development support, not a runtime dependency.

findings.title: Negative source amount accepted as positive
findings.mechanism: Unsigned numeric substring discarded negative/accounting context.
findings.root_cause: Monetary candidates did not preserve signs and parentheses.
findings.recommended_fix: Match complete monetary tokens and reject negative/accounting tokens as positive evidence.

findings.title: Truncated identifier or currency accepted
findings.mechanism: Substring grounding accepted FL-1 from FL-10 or USD from USDT.
findings.recommended_fix: Require complete values with identifier-aware punctuation boundaries.

findings.title: Unrelated numeric token discarded correct amount
findings.mechanism: A parse error in an earlier candidate aborted the complete search.
findings.root_cause: Exception handling surrounded the candidate loop.
findings.recommended_fix: Parse candidates independently and skip invalid candidates only.

findings.title: Malformed provider envelope caused an uncaught exception
findings.mechanism: Successful HTTP responses with choices=[null] or a non-list choices field escaped controlled errors.
findings.root_cause: Envelope shape was assumed before attribute access.
findings.recommended_fix: Validate envelope/list/choice/message types before reading model output.

findings.title: Impossible within-document chronology and non-calendar formats passed
findings.mechanism: Only rate pickup versus POD delivery was compared; fromisoformat also accepted compact/week dates.
findings.root_cause: Missing per-document chronology and explicit calendar-format checks.
findings.recommended_fix: Enforce YYYY-MM-DD and per-document chronology; allow actual delivery later than planned.

findings.title: Missing Content-Length bypassed pre-parser upload budget
findings.mechanism: Multipart data was spooled before endpoint file-size checks.
findings.root_cause: Total request limit relied on an optional header.
findings.recommended_fix: Count actual ASGI request bytes before parsing and preserve partial-file cleanup.

findings.title: Saved reviews outlived validation revisions without provenance
findings.mechanism: Early packet reuse could return findings/approval made by an older validation policy.
findings.root_cause: Fingerprint and saved review omitted policy revisions and configured model provenance.
findings.recommended_fix: Version fingerprints and processing metadata; retain old records but require rechecking before approval/export.

findings.title: PDF expansion lacks a hard CPU or memory boundary
findings.mechanism: extract_text can expand/process compressed page content before the final extracted-text budget check.
findings.root_cause: Parsing runs in-process without time/memory limits.
findings.recommended_fix: Isolate parsing with enforced resource/time limits before untrusted business use.
findings.reproduction: source inspection only; no resource exhaustion stress test
